description: This script contains functions and procedures for upgrading firmware on Ubiquiti Networks devices, specifically for MB7621. It includes functions for updating kernel flags, finding partition information, managing UBI volumes, and performing the upgrade process.

methods.name: ubnt_update_kernel_flag
methods.description: Updates the kernel boot index flag in the device's factory partition to indicate the active kernel slot.

methods.name: platform_upgrade_ubnt_erx
methods.description: Main function to handle the entire upgrade process for the Ubiquiti ER-X device, including partition management and kernel flag update.
